collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: A family's old dog can no longer keep up on fishing trips and spends most days lying by the door.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A family's old dog can no longer keep up on fishing trips and spends most days lying by the door.

choices.label: Carry It Along in a Basket.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The dog seems content in its sunny spot.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The dog whines when the family leaves, so a child stays behind with it some days.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The dog enjoys the sea air and watches the fishing happily.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The dog dislikes the basket and prefers home after all.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healer suggests gentle walks and soft food, which help.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healer says the dog is simply old, and the family focuses on its comfort.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The dog proudly guards the drying racks from seabirds.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The dog falls asleep on duty, and nobody minds at all.
